nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a man dressed in a chef's uniform preparing a dish. He first showcases fresh ingredients, then proceeds to chop potatoes and add the chopped potatoes to a wok, he adds oil to the wok, followed by onions, spices, chopped cherry tomatoes and some chopped herbs, then serves the dish onto a white plate.
The person wears a white chef's coat. Some ingredients are shown at the beginning of the video. The video takes place in a kitchen, in front of a gas stove. There is a shelf with cookware, behind the man. The camera is handheld.

summary.brief: A chef stir‑fries boiled baby potatoes with rosemary, spring onion and cherry tomatoes, then plates the dish.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a title card and a quick showcase of the ingredients—baby potatoes, cherry tomatoes, spring onion, fresh rosemary, paprika, brown sugar, salt and olive oil. The chef, dressed in a white coat, halves the boiled baby potatoes, heats olive oil in a wok, and adds the potato halves, stir‑frying them on high heat until they turn a crisp golden colour. He then tosses in sliced spring onion and chopped rosemary, seasons with paprika, salt and a touch of brown sugar, and briefly covers the wok so the potatoes acquire a light glaze. Halved cherry tomatoes are added next, and the mixture is tossed once more. Finally, fresh spring‑onion greens are sprinkled over the dish, which is plated on a white plate and presented as a ready‑to‑serve rosemary potato side.

action.detailed: Heat olive oil in a wok, add the halved boiled potatoes and stir‑fry them until golden, toss in spring onion and rosemary, season with paprika, salt and brown sugar, cover briefly, add the cherry tomatoes, toss again, finish by sprinkling fresh spring‑onion greens and serve on a plate.

The video features a person demonstrating a recipe by cooking potatoes in a black frying pan. A kitchen counter, ingredients, and several pots are visible in the background.
The person begins by rubbing his hands together over a small glass bowl of potatoes on the kitchen counter. He then moves the bowl to a cutting board, cuts a clove of garlic and places the small bowl of potatoes back on the cutting board. The person then takes a knife from behind him on his right side, cuts the garlic in half, and holds the knife horizontally. He takes a black and silver spoon from behind the bowl of potatoes on the cutting board, stirs the potatoes in the pan with it and then uses the spoon to lift up some of the potatoes. He then stirs the potatoes some more using the spoon and holds them above the pan with a white plate in his other hand. The person holds the spoon up and stirs the potatoes some more.

The person lifts up a black silver lid and raises the lid above the pan before placing it back down.

The person then takes a knife and holds it vertically and cuts a red tomato on the cutting board. The person repeats this once and turns the knife horizontally and completes the cut.

The person lifts the black and silver pan and stirs the potatoes, onions, tomatoes, and seasonings with a black slotted spatula. He then turns the pan and lifts the white plate beside the stove from the kitchen counter. The person lifts the black and silver pan and places the potatoes, onions, tomatoes, and seasonings onto the plate. Finally, the person takes some fresh green onion and sprinkles it over the dish.

The camera then tilts back down and the video ends.

summary.brief: The chef sautés boiled potatoes with garlic, tomato and herbs, then plates the seasoned dish.
summary.detailed: The chef rubs his hands over a small glass bowl of boiled baby potatoes, moves the bowl to a cutting board and chops a clove of garlic, then halves the garlic pieces. He lifts a black‑silver spoon and stirs the potatoes in a hot black frying pan, lifting some potatoes with the spoon while holding a white plate in his other hand. He briefly lifts the pan’s lid, sets it back, then slices a red tomato on the board, first cutting it vertically and then horizontally to finish the cuts. Using a black slotted spatula, he tosses the potatoes together with the garlic, onion pieces, the tomato slices and the seasonings that were already in the pan. He transfers the cooked mixture onto the white plate, sprinkles fresh green onion leaves over the top, and the camera tilts down as the segment ends.

summary_sent_to_llm.description:
Quick recipe of boiled baby potatoes tossed with fresh rosemary.
http://www.facebook.com/ChefSanjeevKapoor
https://twitter.com/sanjeevkapoor
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video opens with a title card and a quick showcase of the ingredients—baby potatoes, cherry tomatoes, spring onion, fresh rosemary, paprika, brown sugar, salt and olive oil. The chef, dressed in a white coat, halves the boiled baby potatoes, heats olive oil in a wok, and adds the potato halves, stir‑frying them on high heat until they turn a crisp golden colour. He then tosses in sliced spring onion and chopped rosemary, seasons with paprika, salt and a touch of brown sugar, and briefly covers the wok so the potatoes acquire a light glaze. Halved cherry tomatoes are added next, and the mixture is tossed once more. Finally, fresh spring‑onion greens are sprinkled over the dish, which is plated on a white plate and presented as a ready‑to‑serve rosemary potato side.
